title: Dataset Clinical Epilepsy iEEG to BIDS -RESPect_intraoperative_iEEG
description: Clinical intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 12 epilepsy surgery patients at the University Medical Center Utrecht, forming part of the RESPect (Registry for Epilepsy Surgery Patients) collection. Six patients were recorded intraoperatively with acute ECoG and six had long-term monitoring (three with ECoG, three with SEEG). The data are organized in BIDS, with separate session and run conventions for intraoperative and long-term recordings.
methods_description: Intraoperative ECoG recordings are grouped into BIDS sessions by surgical situation (pre-resection, intermediate, post-resection), with letters indicating grid and strip/depth position. Long-term iEEG recordings are grouped by monitoring period, with the run label encoding the day and start time of recording. The task label describes patient state (e.g., rest, sleep, clinical SPES).
